historical_significance: 北宋著名思想家、哲学家、教育家，关学创始人，宋明理学奠基人之一。在哲学史上第一次建立了比较完整的气一元论体系，开创了与濂学、洛学、闽学并列的关学学派。其'横渠四句'成为后世读书人的最高理想，'民胞物与'思想深刻影响了中国伦理学传统。
core_thoughts: 太虚即气法（宇宙本体论奠基）
一物两体法（辩证统一思维）
大心体物法（超越闻见的认识论）
知礼成性法（道德修养工夫论）
变化气质法（人性改造方法论）
民胞物与法（普遍伦理学）
横渠四句法（经世致用理想论）
批判佛道法（儒学正统重建）
井田实践法（制度变革试验）
关学建构法（学派传承体系化）
famous_quote: 为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平
influence: 开创关学学派，与周敦颐、邵雍、程颢、程颐并称'北宋五子'，得以从祀孔庙。王夫之称其'上承孔孟之志，下救来兹之失，如皎日丽天'。横渠四句千古传颂，民胞物与思想影响中国伦理学传统至今。
reason_zh: 核心思维模式：M218-M227。张载是北宋最具原创性的哲学家之一，他站在儒学立场上批判佛道二教，建立了以'太虚即气'为核心的完整哲学体系。其思想涵盖宇宙论（太虚即气、一物两体）、认识论（大心体物、知礼成性）、伦理学（民胞物与）、政治实践（井田制试验）和学派建构（关学传承）。横渠四句将个人修养与宇宙关怀融为一体，体现了儒者最高的精神追求。张载一生'慨然有意三代之治'，从少年习兵到中年弃武从文，晚年躬行实践井田制试验，展现了完整的儒者从理论到实践的思维路径。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M218-M227. Zhang Zai was the most original philosopher of Northern Song, standing on Confucian ground to critique Buddhism and Daoism while building a complete philosophical system centered on 'Tai Xu is Qi'. His thought covers ontology (Tai Xu is Qi, One Thing Two Bodies), epistemology (Great Mind comprehends all things, ritual-knowing character formation), ethics (universal brotherhood), political practice (well-field system experiment), and school construction (Guan School transmission). The Four Sentences of Hengqu integrate personal cultivation with cosmic concern, embodying the highest spiritual pursuit of Confucians. Zhang Zai throughout life 'earnestly desired three ancient dynasties' governance', from youth studying military to middle age abandoning arms for texts, in old age personally practicing well-field experiments, demonstrating the complete Confucian path from theory to practice.

modes.definition_zh: 以太虚为气的本然状态，否定佛道以空、无以为本体的观点。太虚无形，气之本体；其聚其散，变化之客形尔。宇宙间不存在绝对的'无'或'空'，一切存在都是气的不同形态——聚则为万物，散则归太虚。
modes.definition_en: Taking Tai Xu (Great Void) as the original state of Qi, rejecting Buddhist and Daoist views that take emptiness/nothingness as ontology. Tai Xu is formless, the original substance of Qi; its aggregation and dispersion are transient forms. The universe contains no absolute 'nothingness' or 'emptiness'; all existence is different states of Qi—when aggregated, it becomes myriad things; when dispersed, it returns to Tai Xu.
process_zh: 否定绝对虚无的存在——'知太虚即气，则无无'
确立气为宇宙唯一实体——'太虚不能无气，气不能不聚而为万物'
解释万物生灭为气的聚散变化——'万物不能不散而为太虚'
构建循环本体论框架：太虚→气化→万物→太虚
process_en: Negate absolute nothingness—'Know Tai Xu is Qi, then there is no nothing'
Establish Qi as the sole cosmic substance—'Tai Xu cannot lack Qi, Qi must aggregate to become myriad things'
Explain birth and death as aggregation/dispersion of Qi—'Myriad things must disperse back to Tai Xu'
Construct cyclic ontology framework: Tai Xu → Qi transformation → Myriad things → Tai Xu
modern_applications: 系统思维中的整体性原理
物质守恒与能量转换思考
否定虚无主义世界观
本体论层面的还原分析

modes.name_en: One Thing Two Bodies Method (Dialectical Unity)
modes.definition_zh: 任何事物内部都包含对立面（阴阳），'有两亦一在，无两亦一在'。矛盾不是外在冲突而是内在统一的基础，对立面相互依存、相互转化，构成了事物运动变化的根本动力。
modes.definition_en: Every thing contains opposing forces (Yin-Yang) within—it has two and one, without two there is still one. Contradiction is not external conflict but the foundation of internal unity; opposites interdepend and transform, forming the fundamental driving force of all change.
process_zh: 识别事物内部的对立统一结构
分析对立面的相互依存关系
理解矛盾双方转化的条件与机制
在对立统一中把握事物的运动规律
process_en: Identify the dialectical structure within any thing
Analyze how opposites interdepend on each other
Understand conditions and mechanisms of contradictory transformation
Grasp the movement laws through unity of opposites
modern_applications: 辩证分析框架
矛盾管理方法论
系统动态平衡思维
对立统一决策模型

modes.definition_zh: '大其心则能体天下之物'，超越感官闻见的有限性，以无限之心体认万物。世人之心止于见闻之狭，圣人尽性不以见闻梏其心。通过扩展心的边界，达到'视天下无一物非我'的境界。
modes.definition_en: 'Expand the great mind and you can comprehend all things under heaven.' Transcend the limited nature of sensory perception; the sage fully actualizes nature without being confined by seeing and hearing. By expanding the mind's boundaries, one reaches the state of 'seeing nothing under heaven as other than myself.'
process_zh: 识别感官闻见的局限性
超越经验认知的边界限制
通过尽性修养扩大心的体认范围
达到'视天下无一物非我'的万物一体境界
process_en: Recognize the limitations of sensory perception
Transcend boundaries of empirical cognition
Expand mind's comprehension through nature-actualizing cultivation
Reach 'seeing all things as self' unified realm
modern_applications: 超越经验主义认知框架
整体性思维训练
跨学科综合理解能力
系统思维的主体修养路径

modes.definition_zh: 通过'知礼'达到'成性'，以礼仪规范为途径塑造和完善人的道德本性。知礼不是外在约束而是内在修养的方法，通过学习和践行礼仪规范来变化气质、成就圣人品格。
modes.definition_en: 'Know ritual to form character'—using ritual norms as the path to shape and perfect moral nature. Knowing ritual is not external constraint but inner cultivation method; by learning and practicing ritual norms, one transforms temperament and achieves sage character.
process_zh: 学习礼仪规范的内容与精神
将外在礼制内化为道德自觉
通过持续践行改变先天气质
最终成就圣人的完整人格
process_en: Study the content and spirit of ritual norms
Internalize external rituals as moral consciousness
Transform innate temperament through continuous practice
Ultimately achieve complete sage personality
modern_applications: 制度内化的修养路径
礼仪教育的人格塑造功能
规范与自由的辩证统一
道德教育的程序化设计

modes.definition_zh: 人人皆有天地之性（善的本源），但受气质所拘而有善恶之分。通过修养工夫可以'变化气质'，恢复天地之性的本然状态。这是张载人性论的核心：既肯定人人可为圣人的可能性，又强调后天修养的必要性。
modes.definition_en: All people possess Heavenly Nature (the origin of goodness), but are constrained by temperament, leading to good/evil distinctions. Through cultivation practice, one can 'transform temperament' and restore the original state of Heavenly Nature—the core of Zhang Zai's theory: affirming everyone's potential to become sage while emphasizing the necessity of后天 cultivation.
process_zh: 认识自身气质之偏与局限
通过读书明理纠正偏差
以礼制约束日常行为
逐步改变气质恢复天地之性
process_en: Recognize one's own temperament biases and limitations
Correct deviations through reading and understanding principles
Constrain daily behavior with ritual discipline
Gradually transform temperament to restore Heavenly Nature
modern_applications: 自我认知与性格改造
教育中的因材施教原理
习惯养成的系统性方法
个人成长的路径规划

modes.name_en: Universal Brotherhood Method (All People Are My Brethren)
modes.definition_zh: '民吾同胞，物吾与也'——天下苍生都是我的手足同胞，天地万物都与我有亲缘关系。将仁爱从血缘扩展到全社会乃至整个自然界，构建了最广泛的伦理关怀体系。
modes.definition_en: 'All people are my brothers, all things are my companions'—all beings under heaven are my siblings, and all things in the cosmos share kinship with me. Expanding benevolence from blood ties to all society and even the natural world, constructing the broadest ethical care system.
process_zh: 确立天为父、坤为母的宇宙家庭观
将所有人视为同胞手足
关怀弱势群体（老、幼、孤、寡、残疾）
将伦理关怀扩展到天地万物
process_en: Establish cosmic family view: Heaven as Father, Earth as Mother
View all people as siblings and fellow beings
Care for vulnerable groups (elderly, young, orphaned, widowed, disabled)
Extend ethical concern to all things under heaven
modern_applications: 普世人权理念的中国表达
环境保护的伦理基础
社会包容性设计思维
全球化时代的人类命运共同体意识

modes.name_en: Four Sentences of Hengqu Method (Cosmic Responsibility Framework)
modes.definition_zh: '为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平'——通过四个'为'字将个人修养与宇宙关怀、历史使命和未来理想融为一体。每个'为'都是主动的担当，而非被动的承受；每个人都可以成为历史的主体。
modes.definition_en: 'Establish heart for Heaven and Earth, establish destiny for the people, continue lost teachings of past sages, open peace for ten thousand generations'—four 'establishing' verbs integrate personal cultivation with cosmic concern, historical mission and future ideal. Each 'for' is active responsibility, not passive acceptance; everyone can become the subject of history.
process_zh: 为天地立心：建立以仁为核心的价值体系
为生民立命：让百姓安身立命、精神有依归
为往圣继绝学：继承发扬儒学传统
为万世开太平：实现理想社会秩序
process_en: Establish heart for Heaven and Earth: build value system centered on benevolence
Establish destiny for people: ensure people have livelihood and spiritual grounding
Continue lost teachings of past sages: inherit and propagate Confucian tradition
Open peace for ten thousand generations: realize ideal social order
modern_applications: 知识分子的使命意识建构
跨代际责任伦理框架
可持续发展的人文基础
全球治理的文明担当

modes.name_en: Critique of Buddhism and Daoism Method
modes.definition_zh: 站在儒学立场上，从宇宙本体论高度批判佛道二教。指出佛家以'空'为本体、道家以'无'为根源都是错误的，建立了气一元论的替代方案。同时吸收佛道思辨方法，将其纳入儒学体系。
modes.definition_en: Standing on Confucian ground, critiquing Buddhism and Daoism from the level of cosmic ontology. Pointing out that Buddhist 'emptiness' and Daoist 'nothingness' as origins are wrong, while building Qi monism alternative. Simultaneously absorbing Buddhist and Daoist dialectical methods into Confucian system.
process_zh: 识别佛道本体论的根本错误
从体用关系角度批判'空''无'概念
建立气一元论的替代宇宙观
吸收佛道思辨方法丰富儒学
process_en: Identify fundamental errors in Buddhist and Daoist ontology
Critique 'emptiness' and 'nothingness' concepts through substance-function relations
Build Qi monism alternative cosmology
Absorb Buddhist-Daoist dialectical methods to enrich Confucianism
modern_applications: 文化批判与重建方法论
跨思想体系的批判性吸收
意识形态竞争中的理论优势建构
多元文化共存中的立场坚守

modes.definition_zh: '论治人先务，未始不以经界为急'——晚年回到横渠，买地实践《周礼》井田制，划分土地、疏通水渠。将抽象的儒家经济理想转化为具体的制度试验，在关中多地实施井田制改革实验。
modes.definition_en: 'In governing people, nothing comes first—always prioritize land boundary regulation'—in old age returned to Hengqu, bought land to practice the Zhou Dynasty's well-field system, dividing land and clearing irrigation channels. Translating abstract Confucian economic ideals into concrete institutional experiments, implementing well-field system reforms across multiple areas in Guanzhong.
process_zh: 将儒家经济理想具体化为可操作的制度设计
选择横渠作为试验基地
实际划分土地、疏通水渠
观察效果并反思完善
process_en: Translate Confucian economic ideals into operable institutional designs
Select Hengqu as experimental base
Actually divide land and clear irrigation channels
Observe results and reflect for improvement
modern_applications: 政策试点与制度创新的系统方法
理想政策的落地路径设计
基层治理的实验精神
理论与实践的双向验证

modes.definition_zh: 创建'关学'学派，通过讲学、著书、培养弟子实现学术传承。从少年习兵到中年弃武从文，从广读佛道到回归儒学，张载完成了学术路线的完整转型，最终在横渠书院创立了影响关中八百年之久的学派体系。
modes.definition_en: Creating the 'Guan School' through teaching, writing, and cultivating disciples to achieve academic transmission. From youth studying military to middle age abandoning arms for texts, from extensively reading Buddhist and Daoist works to returning to Confucianism, Zhang Zai completed a full academic transformation, ultimately founding at Hengqu Academy the school system that influenced Guanzhong for 800 years.
process_zh: 确立独特的学术方向和理论体系
创建横渠书院作为教学基地
培养弟子传承关学精神
通过著作（正蒙、横渠易说等）确立学派经典
process_en: Establish unique academic direction and theoretical system
Create Hengqu Academy as teaching base
Cultivate disciples to transmit Guan School spirit
Establish school classics through writings (Zheng Meng, Hengqu Yi Shuo, etc.)
modern_applications: 学术学派的建设方法论
思想传承的制度化路径
知识体系的系统化整理
理论创新的组织保障

case_zh: 张载（1020—1077），字子厚，祖籍大梁（今河南开封），侨居凤翔郿县横渠镇。少年喜兵法，曾欲结客收复失地于西夏。范仲淹见之，劝其弃武从文，研习儒家经典。张载听从劝告，熟读《中庸》不满足，遂遍读佛道之书，最终回归儒学。嘉祐二年（1057年）中进士，历任祁州司法参军、丹州云岩县令、著作佐郎、崇文院校书等职。熙宁二年（1069年）因与王安石新政法见不合，辞官归隐横渠。在横渠讲学著书，创立关学派别。晚年回乡实践《周礼》井田制，划分土地、疏通水渠。传世著作有《正蒙》《横渠易说》《西铭》《东铭》《经学理窟》，后人编为《张子全书》。其'横渠四句'千古传颂，关学影响关中学术八百年之久。
case_en: Zhang Zai (1020—1077), courtesy name Zihou, ancestral home Daliang (modern Kaifeng, Henan), settled at Hengqu Town in Meixian, Fengxiang. Youthful interest in military strategy, once wished to gather followers to recover lost territories from Western Xia. Fan Zhongyan saw him and advised abandoning arms for texts, studying Confucian classics. Zhang Zai followed advice, mastered 'Doctrine of the Mean' but unsatisfied, then extensively read Buddhist and Daoist works, ultimately returning to Confucianism. Passed jinshi examination in 1057 (Jiayou 2), served successively as judicial assistant at Qizhou, magistrate of Yunyan County at Danzhou, writing assistant director, and archivist at Chongwen Academy. In 1069 (Xining 2), disagreed with Wang Anshi's reform policies, resigned and retired to Hengqu. Taught and wrote at Hengqu, founding the Guan School branch. In old age returned home to practice Zhou Dynasty's well-field system, dividing land and clearing irrigation channels. Surviving works include 'Zheng Meng', 'Hengqu Yi Shuo', 'Xi Ming', 'Dong Ming', 'Jingxue Liku', compiled posthumously as 'Complete Works of Master Zhang'. His Four Sentences have been celebrated through the ages; Guan School influenced Guanzhong scholarship for 800 years.
